tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: The blurred navy field behind the app shell. Never used inside the shell.

tokens.name: shell
tokens.usage: The app shell itself (the large rounded black frame).

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The icon rail on the left of the shell.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panels: Agent Activity, the table, the score and readiness panels, the progress row.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Inner stat cards inside a panel, and the table header row's base.

tokens.name: card-top
tokens.usage: Top of the inner stat card's vertical sheen (card-top to card).

tokens.name: row-head
tokens.usage: Table header row background.

tokens.name: icon-tile
tokens.usage: Square tiles behind small icons (progress row, active nav item).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Table row dividers, the vertical divider in the progress row.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of progress bars, the readiness bar and the score gauge.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and big numbers on shell, panel, card and row-head.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: Goal/Average labels, subtitles, table headers, on panel, card and row-head.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative only: dotted leader lines in stat cards, inactive nav icons' hover ground. Never text.

tokens.name: nav-icon
tokens.usage: Inactive sidebar icons on sidebar (3:1+).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one hue: primary pill button, progress fills, gauge arc, readiness fill, logo tile.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (the Try it now button, the logo glyph).

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Upward trend in tables, always with the up-right arrow, on panel.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Downward trend in tables, always with the down-left arrow, on panel.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Sparkline 1 (cool grey-blue) and its area fill.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Sparkline 2 (warm sand) and its area fill.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Sparkline 3 (sage) and its area fill.

tokens.name: promo-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the promo card's vertical gradient.

tokens.name: promo-mid
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the promo card's gradient.

tokens.name: promo-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the promo card's gradient (the lit floor behind the button).

tokens.name: blob-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest blue of the 3D glass object.

tokens.name: blob-mid
tokens.usage: Mid blue of the 3D glass object.

tokens.name: blob-light
tokens.usage: Highlights of the 3D glass object.
